en.template: Help us plan for an adult rescue dog in {home}. Our office days and door-to-door absences are {schedule}, our comfortable monthly surplus is {surplus}, and our separate emergency savings are {savings}. Compare rental/strata steps, a realistic budget and suitable daytime care for {dog}. Separate published prices from allowances and list what we must confirm with the rescue, vet, insurer and care provider. Draft any questions for us to send; do not submit forms, contact anyone or make commitments on our behalf.

phases.title: Check the NSW rental pet rules, shelter fees, registration and local care prices in public sources
phases.note: Rental rules, adoption fees, registration, vet, training, daycare and insurance prices
phases.judgment: It caught a price that would have flattered the budget: a Marrickville daycare's $26 a day is a three-day introductory pack, not an ongoing rate, so the guide says the regular price is unconfirmed.

phases.title: Build the first-year and ongoing budgets and the guide, with every calculation shown
phases.note: Year one, year two onwards, office-day care options and a fostering suggestion
phases.judgment: It showed how much the answer swings with daycare instead of giving one comfortable number: one daycare day a week costs $9,123.61 in year one and $7,593.61 a year after, while three days a week lifts year one to $15,363.61. Emergency savings stay separate.

phases.title: Independent arithmetic check and page tests at desktop and phone widths
phases.judgment: The independent recount passed with no double counting of the emergency savings, and it caught a date the sources did not support: the guide said the Fair Trading page was “updated 8 October 2026”. It now says the page was checked on 6 November 2026.

workers: Read the official NSW rules on tenants keeping pets, the pet registry fees and the Inner West off-leash areas
Collected current adoption fees and inclusions from Sydney rescues, plus what they say about leaving dogs alone and fostering
Collected published prices for vet visits, training, dog walking, daycare and pet insurance
Recomputed the budget independently and checked the report against its sources
